notes: Proposed by the package itself (the orchestrator's task named the id; work-packages.json had no entry): the slot carries this entry in its WORKING TREE only, the integrator adds it at merge. Ownership of HomePage.tsx, WeekStrip.tsx and HomeNutrition.tsx passes from the closed S-home to this package, which deletes them (their week query and nutrition block live on in features/today/). The three new hooks are NEW files that no gate mirrors or imports: add them to frozen.except as was done for useFinishWorkout.ts. Builds against B-habits-tasks' frontend/src/lib/lifeos-api.ts (its shared.patch): merge B-habits-tasks first. The doors Összes -> /habits, Kész ma -> /tasks, Első szokás -> /habits and Rögzítés (until the capture sheet exists) -> /tasks need S-habits / S-tasks merged before or with this package. Reads the existing home.* keys (greeting, start, resume, restDay, inProgress, done, exerciseCount, todayTitle, emptyTitle, emptyBody) - they keep their namespace.
